newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas mixed as volumes remain disappointing.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas mixed as volumes remain disappointing.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw a slight increase in activity on Tuesday afternoon after a quiet morning session, but by the close only 110 lots had been traded in seven separate deals.

The levels at which trade was done gave mixed signals to the market. July, August, October and March all traded lower than the previous settlement price, while September and November each gained 0.01 pence a therm.
But brokers were unwilling to read too much significance to price movements in such a thin market, with July the only month seeing more than a single trade done.

One futures broker said that his company was now shifting its attention away from natural gas as the lack of volume made the market unattractive. He pointed out that volatility seen at the start of the contract is now settling down, "so there's not much for a futures broker to do."
